services.name: 3 Hours Private Event Hosted On Bay Queen River Boat
services.desc: Enjoy the sunset while cruising around the harbor with our Baywatch family! 1 hour and 30 minutes About Experience the enchanting glow of the beautiful Galveston sunset aboard the Bay Queen, our splendid sidewheeler paddle boat. As you glide across the waters, our 130-passenger vessel offers a magical setting for a serene evening out. Perfect for romantic dates, relaxing family outings, or memorable group events, the Bay Queen’s sunset cruise combines breathtaking scenery with the nostalgic charm of a paddlewheel ride. Join us on deck for a spectacular voyage under the setting sun, Host up to 109 people for your private event on our sidewheeler paddle boat
